wordProblems.q: Adam has 2 marbles. His friend gives him 8 more marbles. How many marbles does Adam have now?
Ruby bakes 8 cookies. She eats 2 of them. How many cookies are left?
There are 6 birds on a tree. 5 birds fly away. How many birds are left on the tree?
Grace has 6 pencils. Grace finds 3 more pencils in a drawer. How many pencils does Grace have now?
Ruby has 8 balloons. 2 balloons pop. How many balloons does Ruby have left?
Zoe has 4 books on her shelf. Her mum buys her 3 more books. How many books does Zoe have now?
Adam has 7 crayons. He loses 6 crayons at school. How many crayons does Adam have left?
Omar picks 5 oranges from a tree. Then Omar picks 4 more oranges. How many oranges did Omar pick in all?
There are 7 ducks in a pond. 6 ducks swim away. How many ducks are left in the pond?
Emma makes 7 cupcakes. Her friend brings 3 more cupcakes. How many cupcakes are there in all?
Noah has 7 toy cars. He gives 4 toy cars to his little brother. How many toy cars does Noah have left?
Sara finds 2 seashells on the beach in the morning and 4 seashells in the afternoon. How many seashells did Sara find in all?
Ava has 7 flowers in her garden. She picks 2 flowers for her teacher. How many flowers are left in the garden?
Liam eats 2 grapes at lunch and 7 grapes after school. How many grapes did Liam eat in all?
Ethan is reading a book with 8 pages. Ethan reads 6 pages today. How many pages are left to read?
A baker makes 4 muffins in the morning and 5 muffins in the afternoon. How many muffins did the baker make in all?
There are 10 fish in a tank. The shop sells 5 fish. How many fish are left in the tank?
Grace has 3 red beads and 7 blue beads. How many beads does Grace have in all?
James collects 8 toy trains. He lends 4 trains to a friend. How many trains does James have left?
Lily has 6 apples in a basket. Lily eats 4 apples. How many apples are left in the basket?
Mason picks 5 lemons from a tree in the morning and 5 lemons in the evening. How many lemons did Mason pick in all?
There are 7 rabbits in a garden. 3 rabbits hop away. How many rabbits are left in the garden?
Owen builds a tower with 2 blocks. Then he adds 8 more blocks on top. How many blocks are in the tower now?
Chloe has 10 buttons in a box. She uses 5 buttons to sew a dress. How many buttons are left in the box?
Layla buys 2 peaches at the market. Then Layla buys 5 more peaches. How many peaches did Layla buy in all?
There are 8 frogs sitting on a log. 6 frogs jump into the water. How many frogs are left on the log?
Ella collects 2 smooth rocks at the river and 5 smooth rocks at the lake. How many smooth rocks did Ella collect in all?
Isabella has 10 cherries in a bowl. She gives 2 cherries to her friend. How many cherries are left in the bowl?
2 red buses and 6 yellow buses are parked at the station. How many buses are parked at the station in all?
Amelia has 9 pairs of socks in a drawer. Amelia takes 4 pairs out to wear this week. How many pairs of socks are left in the drawer?
